<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="it">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Gestione del Verde Pubblico</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:wght@600;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Montserrat:wght@800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--bg:#f4f1e6;--fg:#12332a;--mut:#4d6b5f;--card:#fff;--line:#d9e2d3;--acc:#2f9e5b;--acc2:#e0a526;--bad:#d8553f;--glow:#cfe8c8;
--serif:'Fraunces',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#0d241d;--fg:#f1efe2;--mut:#9cb8aa;--card:#15382d;--line:#245043;--acc:#5fd08a;--acc2:#f0be48;--bad:#ff7a63;--glow:#1c4a3a}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#0d241d;--fg:#f1efe2;--mut:#9cb8aa;--card:#15382d;--line:#245043;--acc:#5fd08a;--acc2:#f0be48;--bad:#ff7a63;--glow:#1c4a3a}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--fg);font-family:var(--sans)}
.deck{position:relative;height:100%}
.s{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:5vh 7vw 10vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:.7s;overflow-x:hidden;overflow-y:auto;
background:radial-gradient(60vw 60vh at 90% 8%,var(--glow),transparent 70%),radial-gradient(40vw 40vh at 0% 100%,var(--glow),transparent 70%)}
.s.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.s>*{position:relative;z-index:2}
.dk{--fg:#f4f1e2;--mut:#c2dccf;--acc:#9be9b0;--acc2:#f5cf5e;--bad:#ff9a7d;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.22)}
.g1{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#0a3a28,#3f7a45)}
.g6{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#134f2a,#5fb262)}
.rise{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px);transition:.8s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.on .rise{opacity:1;transform:none;transition-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*.12s + .25s)}
.k{font-size:clamp(11px,1.3vw,14px);letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--acc);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:1.6vh}
h2{font-family:var(--serif);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.02em;font-size:clamp(26px,4.2vw,52px);font-weight:800;margin-bottom:2.6vh;max-width:17ch}
em{font-style:normal;color:var(--acc)}
.sub{font-size:clamp(14px,1.7vw,20px);color:var(--mut);max-width:38ch;line-height:1.5}
.hills{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;width:100%;height:26vh;color:#a4ecb6;z-index:1;pointer-events:none}
.fl{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;color:var(--acc);opacity:.22;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;animation:fall linear infinite}
@keyframes fall{from{transform:translate(0,-12vh) rotate(0)}to{transform:translate(10vw,112vh) rotate(420deg)}}
.sway{transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:sw 5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes sw{from{transform:rotate(-2deg)}to{transform:rotate(2deg)}}
.split{display:grid;gap:4vw;grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr;align-items:center}
@media(max-width:820px){.split{grid-template-columns:1fr}.s{padding:5vh 6vw 11vh}.hide-m{display:none}}
.row{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;padding:clamp(7px,1.4vh,14px) 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.row svg{flex:none;width:clamp(26px,3vw,36px);height:clamp(26px,3vw,36px);color:var(--acc)}
.row b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(16px,1.9vw,24px)}
.row span{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,15px);line-height:1.4}
.tl{position:relative;padding-left:60px}
.tl:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:20;top:6px;bottom:6px;width:5px;border-radius:9px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7ddc94,#f5cf5e,#ff9a7d,#c9764f)}
.st{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:clamp(6px,1.4vh,14px) 0}
.st i{font-style:normal;font-size:clamp(34px,5vw,60px);line-height:1;flex:none;width:1.3em;text-align:center}
.st b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(16px,1.9vw,24px);display:block}
.st span{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,15px);line-height:1.4}
.map{width:100%;max-height:38vh;border-radius:24px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card)}
.leg{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:13px;color:var(--mut);margin-top:1.6vh}
.leg i{display:inline-block;width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;margin-right:6px}
.path{display:flex;gap:2vw;position:relative;margin-top:90px}
.path:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:6%;right:6%;top:22px;border-top:3px dashed var(--acc);opacity:.6}
.pt{flex:1;text-align:center;position:relative}
.pt:nth-child(even){transform:translateY(1.6vh)}
.pt .o{width:44px;height:44px;margin:0 auto 8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acc);color:#fff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:800;font-size:20px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--glow)}
.pt b{display:block;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(15px,1.8vw,22px)}
.pt span{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(11px,1.2vw,14px);line-height:1.4;display:block;max-width:22ch;margin:2px auto 0}
@media(max-width:820px){.path{flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.path:before{display:none}.pt,.pt:nth-child(even){transform:none;text-align:left;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.pt .o{margin:0;flex:none}.pt span{margin:0;max-width:none}}
.ben b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:clamp(24px,3.6vw,46px);color:var(--acc);display:block;line-height:1.1}
.ben span{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(13px,1.5vw,18px)}
.ben{margin-bottom:2.4vh}
.lt{--fg:#12332a;--mut:#5d6b60;--acc:#4fa83d;--acc2:#e0a526;--line:#d9e2d3;align-items:center;text-align:center;background:radial-gradient(70vw 60vh at 50% 30%,#ffffff,transparent 70%),linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfbf6,#e9f3df)}
.emb{height:min(44vh,60vw);width:auto;aspect-ratio:1;mix-blend-mode:multiply;animation:fl2 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes fl2{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.nm{font-family:'Montserrat',var(--sans);font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(46px,10vw,124px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;margin-top:1vh;color:#0d6a63}
.nm span{color:#7ab829}
.tag{font-size:clamp(15px,2vw,24px);color:var(--mut);max-width:36ch;margin-top:2.4vh;line-height:1.5}
.cap{font-size:clamp(11px,1.3vw,14px);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8f8a7c;font-weight:600;margin-top:2vh}
.nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px) + 2.2vh);display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:14px;z-index:5}
.nav button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);color:var(--fg);width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;font-size:18px;cursor:pointer}
.dots{display:flex;gap:8px}.dots b{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:99px;background:#9bb5a6;opacity:.6;transition:.3s;cursor:pointer}.dots b.on{width:26px;background:var(--acc2);opacity:1}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute">
<symbol id="lf" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 21C3 10 10 3 21 3c0 11-7 18-18 18Z" fill="currentColor"/><path d="M4 20C9 14 13 10 18 6" stroke="rgba(0,0,0,.25)" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none"/></symbol>
<symbol id="tr" viewBox="0 0 60 90"><rect x="27" y="52" width="6" height="38" rx="3" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="30" cy="28" r="22" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="17" cy="46" r="15" fill="currentColor"/><circle cx="43" cy="46" r="15" fill="currentColor"/></symbol>
<symbol id="hl" viewBox="0 0 1440 300" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMax slice">
<path d="M0 150C200 90 400 120 640 150S1100 200 1440 110V300H0Z" fill="currentColor" opacity=".18"/>
<path d="M0 200C240 150 480 190 760 210S1200 200 1440 170V300H0Z" fill="currentColor" opacity=".3"/>
<path d="M0 250C300 215 600 250 900 240S1300 225 1440 240V300H0Z" fill="currentColor" opacity=".45"/>
<use href="#tr" x="180" y="120" width="60" height="90" opacity=".4"/><use href="#tr" x="1120" y="90" width="80" height="120" opacity=".35"/>
<use href="#tr" x="330" y="175" width="45" height="68" opacity=".55"/><use href="#tr" x="1010" y="175" width="40" height="60" opacity=".55"/>
<use href="#tr" x="1280" y="170" width="55" height="80" opacity=".6"/><use href="#tr" x="60" y="170" width="50" height="75" opacity=".6"/>
</symbol></svg>
<div class="deck">
  

<section class="s lt on">
  <img class="emb rise" style="--i:0" alt="Logo Treento" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,">
  <h1 class="nm rise" style="--i:1"><span>TREE</span>NTO</h1>
  <div class="cap rise" style="--i:3">Gestione zone verdi a Trento</div>
  <svg class="hills" style="height:18vh;color:#5cb85c"><use href="#hl"/></svg>
</section>

<section class="s dk g1">
  <div class="split">
    <div>
      <div class="k rise" style="--i:0">Oggi</div>
      <h2 class="rise" style="--i:1">Il verde di Trento, <em>senza un sistema</em></h2>
      <div class="row rise" style="--i:2"><svg><use href="#lf"/></svg><div><b>Dati sparsi</b><span>Excel, telefonate e segnalazioni senza archivio unico.</span></div></div>
      <div class="row rise" style="--i:3"><svg><use href="#lf"/></svg><div><b>Nessuna visione d'insieme</b><span>Nessuno vede a colpo d'occhio lo stato dei luoghi.</span></div></div>
      <div class="row rise" style="--i:4"><svg><use href="#lf"/></svg><div><b>Interventi in emergenza</b><span>Si agisce quando il problema è già evidente.</span></div></div>
      <div class="row rise" style="--i:5"><svg><use href="#lf"/></svg><div><b>Mail scritte a mano</b><span>Ogni lavoro richiede comunicazioni e solleciti manuali.</span></div></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tl">
      <div class="st rise" style="--i:3"><i>🌱</i><div><b>Tutto ok</b><span>Il luogo è curato, ma nessuno lo monitora.</span></div></div>
      <div class="st rise" style="--i:4"><i>🌾</i><div><b>Erba alta</b><span>Nessun avviso: la manutenzione salta.</span></div></div>
      <div class="st rise" style="--i:5"><i>🥀</i><div><b>Segnalazioni</b><span>Arrivano i cittadini, i tempi si allungano.</span></div></div>
      <div class="st rise" style="--i:6"><i>🍂</i><div><b>Costi maggiori</b><span>L'urgenza costa più della programmazione.</span></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <svg class="hills" style="height:20vh"><use href="#hl"/></svg>
</section>



<section class="s dk g6">
  <div class="split">
    <div class="hide-m rise" style="--i:1;text-align:center"><svg class="sway" style="width:min(34vw,340px);color:#0f4a26;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.25))" viewBox="0 0 60 90"><use href="#tr"/></svg></div>
    <div>
      <div class="k rise" style="--i:0">Perché ha senso</div>
      <h2 class="rise" style="--i:1;margin-bottom:4vh">Meno burocrazia, <em style="color:#fff3b0">più città curata</em></h2>
      <div class="ben rise" style="--i:2"><b>Visibilità</b><span>Un unico portale con la situazione di tutti i luoghi.</span></div>
      <div class="ben rise" style="--i:3"><b>Rapidità</b><span>Lavori avviati subito, senza passaggi manuali.</span></div>
      <div class="ben rise" style="--i:4"><b>Risparmio</b><span>Manutenzione preventiva al posto di interventi urgenti.</span></div>
      <div class="ben rise" style="--i:5"><b>Trasparenza</b><span>Storico dei lavori consultabile e verificabile.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <svg class="hills" style="height:20vh;color:#0f4a26"><use href="#hl"/></svg>
</section>
<section class="s">
  <div class="split">
    <div>
      <div class="k rise" style="--i:0">La soluzione</div>
      <h2 class="rise" style="--i:1"> <em>Tree</em>nto </h2>
      <p class="sub rise" style="--i:2">Ogni parco, fontana o area verde è sul portale con il suo stato di degrado, aggiornato e visibile a tutti gli operatori.</p>
      <div class="leg"><span><i style="background:var(--acc)"></i>Buono</span><span><i style="background:var(--acc2)"></i>Da controllare</span><span><i style="background:var(--bad)"></i>Critico</span></div>
    </div>
    <svg class="map rise" style="--i:3" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="Mappa con luoghi colorati per stato">
      <rect width="400" height="300" fill="var(--glow)"/>
      <path d="M0 210 C90 170 150 250 240 205 S360 170 400 200 V300 H0Z" fill="var(--line)" opacity=".7"/>
      <path d="M-10 90 C80 60 140 120 220 80 S340 40 410 70" stroke="var(--card)" stroke-width="14" fill="none" opacity=".9"/>
      <rect x="50" y="120" width="90" height="60" rx="18" fill="var(--acc)" opacity=".25"/>
      <rect x="250" y="130" width="100" height="70" rx="22" fill="var(--acc)" opacity=".25"/>
      <circle cx="95" cy="150" r="14" fill="var(--acc)"/><circle cx="300" cy="165" r="14" fill="var(--bad)"/>
      <circle cx="190" cy="235" r="14" fill="var(--acc2)"/><circle cx="330" cy="50" r="12" fill="var(--acc)"/><circle cx="70" cy="45" r="12" fill="var(--acc2)"/>
      <circle cx="300" cy="165" r="26" fill="none" stroke="var(--bad)" stroke-width="2" opacity=".5"/>
      <rect x="255" y="108" width="92" height="22" rx="11" fill="var(--card)"/>
      <text x="301" y="123" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="var(--bad)" font-family="Inter,sans-serif">Erba alta ⚠</text>
    </svg>
  </div>
  <div class="path">
    <div class="pt rise" style="--i:4"><div class="o">1</div><div><b>Monitora</b><span>Lo stato di ogni luogo è sulla mappa.</span></div></div>
    <div class="pt rise" style="--i:5"><div class="o">2</div><div><b>Valuta</b><span>Processa i dati per stimare la situazione.</span></div></div>
    <div class="pt rise" style="--i:6"><div class="o">3</div><div><b>Avvisa</b><span>Parte in automatico la mail alla ditta.</span></div></div>
    <div class="pt rise" style="--i:7"><div class="o">4</div><div><b>Traccia</b><span>Ogni intervento resta registrato.</span></div></div>
  </div>
</section>
</div>
<div class="nav"><button id="p" aria-label="Precedente">‹</button><div class="dots" id="d"></div><button id="n" aria-label="Successivo">›</button></div>
<script>
var S=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.s')),d=document.getElementById('d'),i=0,D=[];
S.forEach(function(s,k){var b=document.createElement('b');b.onclick=function(){go(k)};d.appendChild(b);D.push(b);
for(var j=0;j<7;j++){var e=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');e.setAttribute('class','fl');e.innerHTML='<use href="#lf"/>';
var z=14+Math.random()*30;e.style.cssText='left:'+(Math.random()*90)+'%;width:'+z+'px;height:'+z+'px;animation-duration:'+(16+Math.random()*16)+'s;animation-delay:-'+(Math.random()*30)+'s';s.appendChild(e)}});
function go(k){i=Math.max(0,Math.min(S.length-1,k));S.forEach(function(s,j){s.classList.toggle('on',j===i)});D.forEach(function(b,j){b.classList.toggle('on',j===i)})}
document.getElementById('p').onclick=function(){go(i-1)};document.getElementById('n').onclick=function(){go(i+1)};
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key===' '||e.key==='PageDown')go(i+1);if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='PageUp')go(i-1)});
var x0=null;document.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){x0=e.touches[0].clientX},{passive:true});
document.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){if(x0===null)return;var dx=e.changedTouches[0].clientX-x0;if(Math.abs(dx)>50)go(i+(dx<0?1:-1));x0=null});
go(0);
</script>
</body>
</html>
